findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.hireahelper.com" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_provider_reviews, list_service_providers, rank_best_providers, get_quote_completion_url, get_provider_details · Private data: get_provider_details · Public sink: send_quote_completion_link, get_quote_completion_url.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_provider_reviews, list_service_providers, rank_best_providers, get_quote_completion_url, get_provider_details · Private data: get_provider_details · Public sink: send_quote_completion_link, get_quote_completion_url

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
